about: Menu paths a page names with {{menu:<id>}}. Each entry: "mac" is the path as the menu bar shows it, items joined by " ▸ ", and must be a path in mac-app/Tests/Goldens/menu-bar.txt; an entry for a menu the golden does not list (Plantoir, Edit, Window) carries "system": true and is checked against help/system-menus.json instead. "windows" is null until the Windows side fills it (P2b); "windowsKey" is that platform's shortcut. The Mac shortcut is read from the golden, never typed here. An id no page uses is a warning; F's --release refuses it.
